subject: Final go/no-go and paperflow for Nimbus MAP — timing and kickoff
messages:
From: Olivia James <olivia.james@nimbusretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dan Chou <dan.chou@nimbusretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & final acceptance window — pre-signoff questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the proposal yesterday. We reviewed the mutual action plan and have two quick questions before we lock dates:

- Can Redwood commit to the Nov 15 start date if legal signoff is EOD Nov 6? Procurement needs to align on a PO lead time.
- We need SOC 2 evidence and a short list of the operational controls you will provide during the eval window. Will that be provided before signatures?

I've attached our updated MAP (Nimbus_MAP_request_v2.xlsx) with our requested milestone tweaks — mostly procurement timing and a one-week stabilization buffer.

If you can confirm a firm DocuSign send date and whether Redwood will accept net-30 billing, we can circle back to legal and procurement.

Olivia
VP of Product
Nimbus Retail

Attachment: Nimbus_MAP_request_v2.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia.james@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Dan Chou <dan.chou@nimbusretail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & final acceptance window — pre-signoff questions

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the MAP.

Summary / proposed plan:
- Signature target: send DocuSign on Mon Nov 6 with request to complete signatures by EOD Nov 6 to preserve the proposed timeline.
- Start date: provisional Nov 15 but contingent on procurement PO arrival; if PO slips we'll move to Nov 22 (see procurement note below).
- SOC 2: we will provide the SOC 2 summary and controls matrix by Nov 5; full report available under NDA (we can share an excerpt for your procurement).
- Billing: Redwood can accept Net 30 on this deal; finance will run a credit check and confirm any pre-pay requirements.

I've attached a streamlined MAP (proposed_MAP_v3.pdf) and a signature checklist (signature_checklist.docx) that lists signers, DocuSign envelope approach, and a short esign fallback if legal needs countersignature on paper.

Action items for Nimbus:
- Dan: can procurement commit to delivering PO terms and ETA by Nov 5 so we avoid the push?
- Olivia: please confirm you and legal are comfortable with the adjusted milestone that adds a one-week stabilization buffer post-launch.

Internal notes: Laura (Legal) — redlines from Nimbus Legal are mostly standard; I flagged two clauses for your quick review (exclusivity language and data retention). Rishi (Finance) — can you confirm Net 30 and any holdbacks we should expect?

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_MAP_v3.pdf, signature_checklist.docx

From: Dan Chou <dan.chou@nimbusretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia James <olivia.james@nimbusretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & final acceptance window — pre-signoff questions

Marcus — quick reply from procurement side.

We typically need five business days to process a PO for an enterprise contract once commercial terms are signed. If signatures are EOD Nov 6, that pushes a PO arrival to roughly Nov 13 or 14. Given internal resource constraints on our side, I think Nov 22 as kickoff is the safer play.

Also, legal asked for the SOC 2 controls summary before countersignature; they will accept the controls matrix as FYI but will want the final report after the envelope executes.

I can escalate for faster PO processing if we absolutely need Nov 15, but that will require signoff from my SVP.

—Dan
Director, Procurement
Nimbus Retail

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: signoff ask — Nimbus Retail (deal NIM-4821)

Laura / Rishi — internal-only note to capture approvals and timeline we discussed over Slack. Please treat as time-sensitive.

What I need from you by EOB Nov 6:
- Legal (Laura): confirm redlines_Legal_NIM-4821.pdf is acceptable. Two items I flagged: data retention appendix (we agreed to a 90-day customer KV cache retention for eval) and the liability cap language — propose to keep at $1M for pilot. If you can approve or provide suggested language tonight, I will accept on behalf of Sales.
- Finance (Rishi): confirm Net 30 is OK and advise on any required credit terms to avoid a holdback. If Finance needs a deposit, tell me amount and we'll surface to the customer.

Why Nov 6? We want to send DocuSign on the 6th to give Nimbus procurement maximum time; per Dan procurement needs 5 business days which lands PO in mid-Nov. That aligns us to a Nov 22 kickoff with one-week stabilization buffer after the evaluation window.

Attached: redlines_Legal_NIM-4821.pdf, billing_memo_NIM-4821.docx

If either of you wants a quick call today to clear outstanding items, stand-by open 4–5pm PT.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Sales, West

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia James <olivia.james@nimbusretail.com>, Dan Chou <dan.chou@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Go/No-Go and executed agreement (NIM-4821) — kickoff confirmed Nov 22

Olivia / Dan — great news: we sent the DocuSign envelope this morning and both Olivia and Dan have completed signatures. DocuSign envelope ID: 0ABC1234DEF5678.

What this means:
- Agreement executed: executed_agreement_NIM-4821.pdf attached.
- Procurement PO: Dan indicated PO will arrive next week (on track for mid-Nov).
- Start date: we will plan for Nov 22 kickoff (one-week stabilization buffer included).
- SOC 2 controls summary was uploaded to your secure link on Nov 5; full report available under NDA and will be delivered per the checklist.

Next actions (owners):
- Marcus: finalize onboarding schedule and send calendar invites for kickoff (by Nov 9).
- Olivia: confirm internal resources for the Nov 22 week (SRE and product partner).
- Rishi: confirm invoicing contact and finalize Net 30 billing.
- Laura: archive executed agreement and confirm any post-signature obligations.

Thanks everyone — glad to get this over the finish line. Looking forward to a smooth kick.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference

Attachments: executed_agreement_NIM-4821.pdf
